name: Compensation Request 1
definition: Provides the time period for the request and account compensation should be credited to.

CompensationAccount.name: Compensation Account
CompensationAccount.definition: Account to which compensation is due.

Period.name: Period
Period.definition: Date range for which the compensation applies.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Estimated compensation due for the request as calculated by the requestor.

ExpectedValueDate.name: Expected Value Date
ExpectedValueDate.definition: Value date on which the compensation is requested to be paid.

InterestRate.name: Interest Rate
InterestRate.definition: Interest rate of a financial instrument used to estimate the compensation.

Reason.name: Reason
Reason.definition: Specifies the reason for the compensation.
